verdict.rationale: Exa has a dedicated rate-limits docs page stating that endpoints have default rate limits (exa-docs-16), and you can set a lower limit per API key (exa-docs-42). Billing is self-serve and pay-as-you-go: you add credits, configure auto recharge and view invoices with no subscription (exa-docs-41, exa-docs-63, exa-docs-62). However, the evidence never shows the actual limit values, any concurrency caps, or that buying credits raises those limits. missing for 10: specific documented rate-limit numbers per endpoint, documented concurrency caps, evidence that a self-serve upgrade raises rate limits, independent corroboration.
